what: A time label like 18:00 attached to each scene stands 30 minutes earlier (17:30), then when it enters the screen it climbs one minute at a time after .3s and stops at its own time — the interval gets shorter as fewer minutes remain (60 − remaining minutes in ms, 30 steps over about 1.3s), and only the last 3 minutes stretch by 90ms each to settle slowly. For scenes that use time as story beats, like a daily schedule or check-in guide

options.Text · data-time: Stop time (H:MM or HH:MM) — as literal text or data-time
options.back: How many minutes ahead to start, default 30
options.delay: Seconds from entering the screen to the first step, default .3
options.tail: Last minute count to slow to a stop, default 3
options.slow: Extra gap added for the last items (ms), default 90
options.fx:show: Once sent, it starts regardless of scroll (one time)

from.where: about.html .bh-scene__time (original concept.bundle — writes the time minus 30 minutes first, then when .time is inview, countUp after 300ms: on each between-- step 60−between ms, if between ≤ 3 then 60−between+90 ms, between < stops at 0)
